market_question: Abstract FDV above $200M one day after launch?
reasoning: Abstract is a new L2 from the Pudgy Penguins team with strong brand recognition, but $200M FDV one day after launch is quite high for an unproven chain. While many recent L2 tokens launched at multi-billion FDVs, those were established networks. Abstract may not launch for years, and market conditions could shift dramatically. I estimate a 68% chance of YES, below the market’s 76.5%, so No is the better bet.
evidence_points: Pudgy Penguins brand has loyal community but no track record as a blockchain developer.
Many L2 tokens (ARB, OP, STRK) launched above $200M FDV, but they had longer development and stronger infrastructure.
Token may not launch until late 2025–2027, increasing risk of a bear market or project pivot.
sources_consulted: General knowledge of Abstract and Igloo Inc.
